name.en-US: Exclamations of the Soul to God

description.es-ES: Diecisiete exclamaciones que Santa Teresa escribió en 1569, después de comulgar, en diversos días y conforme al espíritu que el Señor le comunicaba: el destierro de la vida, el deseo de ver a Dios, el amor, el arrepentimiento y la confianza. Texto crítico del P. Silverio de Santa Teresa, con sus notas.
description.en-US: Seventeen exclamations St. Teresa wrote in 1569, after Communion, on different days and as the Lord moved her: the exile of this life, the longing to see God, love, repentance and trust. P. Silverio de Santa Teresa's critical text with his notes.
description.pt-BR: Dezessete exclamações que Santa Teresa escreveu em 1569, depois da comunhão: o desterro desta vida, o desejo de ver a Deus, o amor, o arrependimento e a confiança.

sources.edition: Obras de Sta. Teresa de Jesús, ed. P. Silverio de Santa Teresa, C.D., t. IV: Moradas, Conceptos del amor de Dios, Exclamaciones (Biblioteca Mística Carmelitana), Burgos: El Monte Carmelo, 1917, pp. 269–296. Princeton Theological Seminary scan, primary OCR.
sources.description: Spanish critical text with Silverio's notes kept as footnotes; his introduction and appendices are not included. OCR of two independent scans merged word by word.
sources.tierEvidence: Teresa died in 1582; the volume was published in 1917 (public domain in the US) and P. Silverio died in 1954, so his notes are public domain under life+70 since 1 January 2025.

sources.edition: The same volume, Wellesley College scan, used as the second witness.
